Meet the chef behind every twirl

Our green bowl chef started as a simple idea: kids and grown-ups both deserve noodles that don't compromise. So every NutriTwirl pack swaps refined flour for millets and whole grains, and folds in real vegetables — without losing the slurp-it-up fun of a noodle night.

No preservatives, no maida, and always tested for taste by the pickiest eaters we know: actual kids.
